parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Optional. If not specified, no resource type restriction is applied.

parameters.name: TagResourceMatchers
parameters.description: The tag resource matchers. Required. A list of rules for matching resources by tag. Each item contains Key (the tag key), Operator (the operator, which supports EQUAL for exact tag key-value match, KEY_EXIST for tag key existence, and KEY_EXIST_NOT_EQUAL for tag key existence with a non-matching value), and Values (the list of tag values).
